verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing says that when someone leaves, it automatically updates access, permissions, and groups and revokes access (docs-18, docs-1). It also says it provisions instantly with "no SCIM lag" across SCIM/SAML-connected apps (docs-23, docs-31, docs-4), and that offboarding triggers downstream workflows (docs-8). However, active-session termination is never mentioned, and the evidence is high-level marketing rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: explicit session revocation on deactivation, detailed docs on per-app deprovisioning behavior and timing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
